description: Error shapes the live Citi Bike GBFS 1.1 feed already produces. A shape is the file, the JSON Schema path and the keyword. The same error on many stations or languages is one shape. Rewrite this file with npm run gbfs:baseline after a new shape is accepted.

shapes.note: gbfs.json lists ebikes_at_stations, which is not a GBFS 1.1 feed name.
gbfs_versions.json publishes version strings such as "v1.1" instead of "1.1".
Some station_status.json stations report last_reported earlier than the schema minimum of 1450155600.
system_pricing_plans.json is_taxable is not a number (0 or 1).
system_pricing_plans.json price is not a number.
